name: PGMaps estimate of migratory bird nest-density rank
assumption: The route card tool ranks each forest inventory stand from 1 (low nest density) to 6 (high) with an industry nest-density matrix (BEC zone, stand type, age class and height class) that is not published. PGMaps estimates the rank with this stated rule instead: older and taller stands rank higher, a deciduous share raises the rank, and pure pine and black spruce stands lower it. It is an estimate for planning, never the matrix: confirm the ranks with the route card tool or enter them.
calibration: Against the ranks the route card tool printed for eleven blocks and roads (VRI rank 1 read in November 2026): 4 of 11 exact, 28 of the 34 printed ranks found. The tool appears to rank an older inventory: back-dating the stands about seven years made 5 of 11 exact.
